title: SynerPlant Yield V2 - pre-registered analysis of the independent 2024-2026 TEST
test_status_at_registration: NOT OPENED: no TEST file has been read by any V2 code

metrics: coverage simultaneous (share of studies fully covered)

success_criteria.coverage_single: observed >= 0.85 (nominal 0.90); report exact binomial 95% CI over studies
success_criteria.accuracy: TEST group-MAE within the 95% range of the TRAIN cross-validated fold MAE (<= 0.361 + 2 x 0.113 = 0.587); otherwise report transport failure

conditional_models.definition: D = ln(S/C) = ln(1 - expected relative yield loss caused by the stress); in deployment D is the user's prior estimate; on TEST it is taken from the factorial S and C arms
conditional_models.eligible_TEST_rows: TEST SB-vs-S yield contrasts built with the V2 rules whose experiment also has C (no stress, no biostimulant) and, for C3, B arms in the same unit/timepoint

success_criteria.1_gain: group-MAE of C1 at least 10% below the frozen median on the same TEST rows
success_criteria.2_beyond_coupling: observed gain above the 95th percentile of the gains obtained in 500 null worlds built from the TEST data (study effects permuted across studies, fresh arm sampling error) - controls the shared-S artefact
success_criteria.3_slope: between-study slope of ln(SB/S) on D on TEST: 95% study-bootstrap CI below 0 and outside the null-world 95% band
success_criteria.verdict: CONFIRMED only if 1-3 hold; PARTIAL if 3 holds without 1; NOT CONFIRMED otherwise

rejected_before_TEST.nominal_intensity_models: X2: Maas-Hoffman/FAO-33 expected damage and raw intensity scales have no across-study validity (Spearman 0.02; CV worse than median)

forbidden: re-fitting or re-tuning any model on TEST
changing V2 inclusion rules after opening TEST
dropping TEST studies after seeing their errors
dataset_rules: TEST contrasts must be built with the frozen V2 rules (corrections_register.json, s03_build_dataset.py tiers/dedup/exclusions) from the TEST DATA_FREEZE; mapping of moderators is irrelevant for the median and the conditional models (they use no moderators)
